t: MFFS $(5)Identification Card$() are used in combination with the $(l:mffs:machines/biometric_identifier)Biometric Identifier$() to govern the rights and privileges of players.
MFFS $(5)识别卡$()需与$(l:mffs:machines/biometric_identifier)生物识别器$()配合使用，以管理玩家的权限与特权。

Before an Identification Card can be used, it needs to be assigned to a player. An Identification Card can be assigned to yourself by shift-right-clicking while holding the card. You can also shift-right-click other players to assign the card to them. Activate the card again to clear the stored identity.
识别卡在启用前，需先分配给某位玩家。您可通过手持识别卡并按住Shift键右击，将卡片分配给自己；亦可通过按住Shift键右击其他玩家，将卡片分配给他们。再次激活卡片，即可清除其中已存储的身份信息。
